text:
Glen Powell wore a solid gold Omega to the Golden Globes.

It is the Omega Seamaster Aqua Terra 38, with a blue dial. Solid gold means the metal runs all the way through, not a thin plating over steel. Press coverage put the gold version at US$39,800.

Would you wear gold to black tie, or stick with steel?

#Omega #GlenPowell #GoldenGlobes #LuxuryWatches #WatchesSpotted

Source: Robb Report Singapore, Golden Globes 2026 watch coverage; Omega's Golden Globes release (WorldTempus); Bloomberg Línea, Golden Globes 2026 watch prices (US$39,800, gold model). Spotted wearing at the 83rd Golden Globes, January 2026.
